title: 逆打工法地下結構
summary: 本課以追蹤逆打樓板、預置柱與連續壁的分階段荷載為主線，從永久樓板的早期支撐與預置柱軸力與未支撐長度建立系統邊界，再把牆板接頭與剪力交接、地下水卸載與地層回彈連到施工歷程與永久文件。永久構件會先作臨時支撐，施工有效長度和接頭狀態不可沿用竣工值。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
summaryEn: This course focuses on track staged loads in top-down slabs, plunge columns and diaphragm walls. It begins with Permanent slabs as early braces and Plunge-column force and unbraced length, links Wall-slab joints and shear transfer and Groundwater unloading and ground rebound, and ends with Construction history and permanent records. Permanent members first act as temporary support; construction lengths and joint states differ from final values. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例所有輸入均為教學假設。首先檢查永久樓板的早期支撐：axialStiffness=E*A/L=30 GPa*0.30 m2/20 m=450 MN/m；再獨立檢查預置柱軸力與未支撐長度：EulerRatio=(oldLength/newLength)^2=(4 m/8 m)^2=0.25 at unchanged EI and end conditions。樓板軸向面積 0.30 m2、模數 30 GPa 固定，跨長由 20 增為 25 m，理想軸向剛度由 450 降為 360 MN/m，降低 20%；開口與接頭另會減弱。 兩個結果不能自動組成完整設計，因為永久構件會先作臨時支撐，施工有效長度和接頭狀態不可沿用竣工值。 將把每階段牆移增量與板柱應變及實際工序共同對照作為模型以外的驗證證據，並保留原始紀錄與尚待確認的邊界。
workedExample.textEn: All inputs in this integrated example are teaching assumptions. First check Permanent slabs as early braces: axialStiffness=E*A/L=30 GPa*0.30 m2/20 m=450 MN/m. Independently check Plunge-column force and unbraced length: EulerRatio=(oldLength/newLength)^2=(4 m/8 m)^2=0.25 at unchanged EI and end conditions. At area 0.30 m2 and modulus 30 GPa, increasing length from 20 to 25 m lowers ideal axial stiffness from 450 to 360 MN/m, by 20%; openings and joints add further reductions. The two results are not a complete design because permanent members first act as temporary support; construction lengths and joint states differ from final values. Use compare stage wall increments with slab-column strain and actual sequence as evidence independent of the calculation, retaining raw records and unverified boundaries.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「永久樓板的早期支撐」與「預置柱軸力與未支撐長度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Permanent slabs as early braces" and "Plunge-column force and unbraced length": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 永久樓板的早期支撐：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Permanent slabs as early braces: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「永久樓板的早期支撐」如何影響逆打工法地下結構的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Permanent slabs as early braces” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Top-down underground construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 逆打先建立部分永久樓板，讓它們在向下開挖時支撐連續壁。樓板此時承受水平壓力與自身施工荷載，和竣工垂直受彎狀態不同；接頭、開口與混凝土齡期決定可用剛度，不能把全樓完成模型直接套用。 判別這個機制時，應觀察對照樓板齡期、接頭狀態及牆體位移與板內應變；若出現未完成的板牆連接被當成剛接，牆移超過預估，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「永久樓板的早期支撐」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Top-down slabs brace diaphragm walls while excavation proceeds below them. They carry lateral compression and construction loads, unlike only their final vertical bending role. Joints, openings and concrete age define available stiffness, preventing direct use of a fully completed-building model. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare slab age and joints with wall movement and in-plane strain. If an incomplete slab-wall connection is assumed rigid and wall movement exceeds prediction, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Permanent slabs as early braces” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：axialStiffness=E*A/L=30 GPa*0.30 m2/20 m=450 MN/m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: axialStiffness=E*A/L=30 GPa*0.30 m2/20 m=450 MN/m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「永久樓板的施工受力必然與竣工受力完全相同」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Permanent slabs have identical construction-stage and final-state loading" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「永久樓板的早期支撐」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Permanent slabs as early braces”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 永久樓板的早期支撐：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Permanent slabs as early braces: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「永久樓板的早期支撐」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Permanent slabs as early braces” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：axialStiffness=E*A/L=30 GPa*0.30 m2/20 m=450 MN/m。永久構件會先作臨時支撐，施工有效長度和接頭狀態不可沿用竣工值。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: axialStiffness=E*A/L=30 GPa*0.30 m2/20 m=450 MN/m. Permanent members first act as temporary support; construction lengths and joint states differ from final values. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對照樓板齡期、接頭狀態及牆體位移與板內應變。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare slab age and joints with wall movement and in-plane strain.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 永久樓板的早期支撐：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Permanent slabs as early braces: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「永久樓板的早期支撐」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Permanent slabs as early braces” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對照樓板齡期、接頭狀態及牆體位移與板內應變。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「未完成的板牆連接被當成剛接，牆移超過預估」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare slab age and joints with wall movement and in-plane strain. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: An incomplete slab-wall connection is assumed rigid and wall movement exceeds prediction. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將對照樓板齡期、接頭狀態及牆體位移與板內應變列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現未完成的板牆連接被當成剛接，牆移超過預估，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare slab age and joints with wall movement and in-plane strain. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If an incomplete slab-wall connection is assumed rigid and wall movement exceeds prediction, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：未完成的板牆連接被當成剛接，牆移超過預估。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An incomplete slab-wall connection is assumed rigid and wall movement exceeds prediction. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: An incomplete slab-wall connection is assumed rigid and wall movement exceeds prediction. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將對照樓板齡期、接頭狀態及牆體位移與板內應變列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現未完成的板牆連接被當成剛接，牆移超過預估，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。

If an incomplete slab-wall connection is assumed rigid and wall movement exceeds prediction, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「永久樓板的早期支撐」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Permanent slabs as early braces"?
options: 對照樓板齡期、接頭狀態及牆體位移與板內應變。

optionsEn: Compare slab age and joints with wall movement and in-plane strain.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A compliant final displacement proves every intermediate construction stage was normal

steps.title: 永久樓板的早期支撐：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Permanent slabs as early braces: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「永久樓板的早期支撐」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Permanent slabs as early braces” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 未完成的板牆連接被當成剛接，牆移超過預估。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到對照樓板齡期、接頭狀態及牆體位移與板內應變，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An incomplete slab-wall connection is assumed rigid and wall movement exceeds prediction. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare slab age and joints with wall movement and in-plane strain to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

quiz.question: 在「預置柱軸力與未支撐長度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「柱位偏差與荷載偏心」與「樓板開口與壓力繞行」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Column positioning and load eccentricity" and "Slab openings and force detours": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 柱位偏差與荷載偏心：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Column positioning and load eccentricity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「柱位偏差與荷載偏心」如何影響逆打工法地下結構的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Column positioning and load eccentricity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Top-down underground construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 預置柱深埋端的偏位難以在後續修正，柱頂和柱底不共線會讓垂直荷載產生彎矩。平面位置合格也不代表垂直度合格，需沿深度量測；局部接頭可能吸收幾何差，但不可因此忽略偏心力和施工容差。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較柱頂、樓板交點及可取得深部軸線量測；若出現柱底偏位被地表控制點漏掉，上方荷載形成額外彎矩，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「柱位偏差與荷載偏心」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Embedded plunge-column offsets are difficult to correct, and misaligned ends convert vertical force into bending. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare column tops, slab intersections and available deep-axis measurements. If a hidden base offset escapes surface control and adds moment under upper loads, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Column positioning and load eccentricity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 柱位偏差與荷載偏心：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Column positioning and load eccentricity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「柱位偏差與荷載偏心」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Column positioning and load eccentricity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：M=N*e=3000 kN*0.025 m=75 kNm。永久構件會先作臨時支撐，施工有效長度和接頭狀態不可沿用竣工值。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: M=N*e=3000 kN*0.025 m=75 kNm. Permanent members first act as temporary support; construction lengths and joint states differ from final values. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較柱頂、樓板交點及可取得深部軸線量測。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare column tops, slab intersections and available deep-axis measurements.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：M=N*e=3000 kN*0.025 m=75 kNm。永久構件會先作臨時支撐，施工有效長度和接頭狀態不可沿用竣工值。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。

steps.title: 柱位偏差與荷載偏心：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Column positioning and load eccentricity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「柱位偏差與荷載偏心」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Column positioning and load eccentricity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較柱頂、樓板交點及可取得深部軸線量測。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「柱底偏位被地表控制點漏掉，上方荷載形成額外彎矩」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare column tops, slab intersections and available deep-axis measurements. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A hidden base offset escapes surface control and adds moment under upper loads. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將比較柱頂、樓板交點及可取得深部軸線量測列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現柱底偏位被地表控制點漏掉，上方荷載形成額外彎矩，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare column tops, slab intersections and available deep-axis measurements. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a hidden base offset escapes surface control and adds moment under upper loads, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：柱底偏位被地表控制點漏掉，上方荷載形成額外彎矩。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A hidden base offset escapes surface control and adds moment under upper loads. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.instruction: 核對每階段開口範圍、洞邊鋼筋與板內應變分布。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「出土孔臨時加大卻未更新模型，剩餘板帶壓裂」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.title: 牆板接頭與剪力交接：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「牆板接頭與剪力交接」如何影響逆打工法地下結構的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Wall-slab joints and shear transfer” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Top-down underground construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 樓板與連續壁接頭需傳遞施工水平作用及永久荷載，預留筋、接合器和界面品質共同控制。回填或粉塵可能污染隱蔽接面，名義鋼筋量不能證明接頭已動員；需在下一階段開挖前確認完整的力線與品質證據。 判別這個機制時，應觀察核對接合器、接面清理與接頭位移及裂縫紀錄；若出現接頭局部空洞導致剪力集中，樓板整體強度合格仍滑移，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「牆板接頭與剪力交接」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Wall-slab joints transfer temporary lateral and permanent actions through bars, couplers and interface quality. steps.title: 樓板下出土與荷載歷程：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Under-slab excavation and loading history: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「樓板下出土與荷載歷程」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Under-slab excavation and loading history” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：stockpilePressure=unitWeight*height=18 kN/m3*2 m=36 kPa。永久構件會先作臨時支撐，施工有效長度和接頭狀態不可沿用竣工值。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: stockpilePressure=unitWeight*height=18 kN/m3*2 m=36 kPa. Permanent members first act as temporary support; construction lengths and joint states differ from final values. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對照土堆高度、機具位置和樓板下方已開挖範圍。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare stockpile height and plant positions with the excavated footprint beneath slabs.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 樓板下出土與荷載歷程：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「樓板下出土與荷載歷程」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Under-slab excavation and loading history” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對照土堆高度、機具位置和樓板下方已開挖範圍。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「同一樓板上堆土而下方支承已移除，局部彎曲增加」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare stockpile height and plant positions with the excavated footprint beneath slabs. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Stockpiling above an excavated unsupported area increases local slab bending. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare stockpile height and plant positions with the excavated footprint beneath slabs. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If stockpiling above an excavated unsupported area increases local slab bending, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：同一樓板上堆土而下方支承已移除，局部彎曲增加。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Stockpiling above an excavated unsupported area increases local slab bending. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.explanationEn: Compare stockpile height and plant positions with the excavated footprint beneath slabs. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 樓板下出土與荷載歷程：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Under-slab excavation and loading history: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「樓板下出土與荷載歷程」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Under-slab excavation and loading history” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 同一樓板上堆土而下方支承已移除，局部彎曲增加。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到對照土堆高度、機具位置和樓板下方已開挖範圍，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Stockpiling above an excavated unsupported area increases local slab bending. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare stockpile height and plant positions with the excavated footprint beneath slabs to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察對照土堆高度、機具位置和樓板下方已開挖範圍；若出現同一樓板上堆土而下方支承已移除，局部彎曲增加，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If stockpiling above an excavated unsupported area increases local slab bending, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「樓板設計承受使用荷載就能承受任何施工堆料」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A slab designed for service loads can carry any construction stockpile" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 地下水卸載與地層回彈：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Groundwater unloading and ground rebound: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「地下水卸載與地層回彈」如何影響逆打工法地下結構的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Groundwater unloading and ground rebound” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Top-down underground construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 開挖減少總應力，降水又增加有效應力，兩者可能造成方向相反的變形。底部回彈與鄰地沉陷可以同時發生，不能用一個水位或沉陷點代表整個場域；模型需保留不同土層壓縮性和排水時間尺度。 判別這個機制時，應觀察同步分析坑底回彈、鄰地沉陷與分層孔隙水壓；若出現只觀察坑內回彈漏掉外部壓密，鄰房逐步差異沉陷，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「地下水卸載與地層回彈」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Excavation reduces total stress while dewatering increases effective stress, potentially causing opposite movements. Base rebound and neighbouring settlement can occur together, so one level or displacement cannot represent the site. Retain layer compressibility and drainage time scales in the assessment. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Analyze base rebound, neighbouring settlement and interval pore pressures together. If monitoring only internal rebound misses external consolidation and differential building settlement, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Groundwater unloading and ground rebound” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：effectiveStressIncrease=gammaW*drawdown=9.81 kN/m3*4 m=39.24 kPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: effectiveStressIncrease=gammaW*drawdown=9.81 kN/m3*4 m=39.24 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「坑底回彈就代表周邊地層不可能同時沉陷」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Base rebound means surrounding ground cannot simultaneously settle" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「地下水卸載與地層回彈」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.instructionEn: Monitoring only internal rebound misses external consolidation and differential building settlement. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If monitoring only internal rebound misses external consolidation and differential building settlement, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「坑底回彈就代表周邊地層不可能同時沉陷」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Base rebound means surrounding ground cannot simultaneously settle" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.instruction: 按構件編號連結工序、荷載、接頭檢查與竣工版本。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「改造人員誤拆看似臨時構件，破壞永久樓板支撐」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Link sequence, loads, joint inspections and as-built revisions by component identifier. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Renovation removes an apparently temporary member and disrupts permanent slab support. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將按構件編號連結工序、荷載、接頭檢查與竣工版本列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現改造人員誤拆看似臨時構件，破壞永久樓板支撐，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Link sequence, loads, joint inspections and as-built revisions by component identifier. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If renovation removes an apparently temporary member and disrupts permanent slab support, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：改造人員誤拆看似臨時構件，破壞永久樓板支撐。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Renovation removes an apparently temporary member and disrupts permanent slab support. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 施工歷程與永久文件：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Construction history and permanent records: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「施工歷程與永久文件」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Construction history and permanent records” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 改造人員誤拆看似臨時構件，破壞永久樓板支撐。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到按構件編號連結工序、荷載、接頭檢查與竣工版本，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Renovation removes an apparently temporary member and disrupts permanent slab support. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to link sequence, loads, joint inspections and as-built revisions by component identifier to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察按構件編號連結工序、荷載、接頭檢查與竣工版本；若出現改造人員誤拆看似臨時構件，破壞永久樓板支撐，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If renovation removes an apparently temporary member and disrupts permanent slab support, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「工程完工後所有施工階段資料都沒有維護價值」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Construction-stage records have no maintenance value after project completion" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
